Container.Name: AutoDate
Container.Overview: Scans a folder on a schedule and reads the original dates of the files stored inside every archive (zip, rar, 7z and tar, including multi-part sets) without extracting anything. The Archives table shows when each archive was made and how old its contents really are, so you can find archives that look new but hold old files (for example created in 2026 with contents from 10 years ago), then rename them with the year of their contents or delete them (to the Recycle Bin, a trash folder, or permanently) after a preview. Nothing is ever changed unless you select archives and confirm. Web UI with live status, settings, scan history, statistics and themes. Created entirely by AI (Claude). It has been tested, but not in every situation - do your own due diligence before relying on it with data you cannot replace, and before exposing it to the internet.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Settings, archive index, history, statistics and logs. Keep the Container Path /data.

Config.Name: Folder to scan
Config.Description: The share to scan (read/write), e.g. /mnt/user/downloads. Keep the Container Path /downloads.

Config.Name: Trash folder (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. /mnt/user/trash. If set, archives you delete in the web UI are moved here instead of being deleted. Otherwise they can go to the share's .Recycle.Bin (Unraid Recycle Bin plugin) or be deleted permanently - see Settings. Must not be inside the folder to scan (or a parent of it). Keep the Container Path /trash.

Config.Name: All shares (optional)
Config.Description: Optional, e.g. /mnt/user. Lets the web UI browse and scan any share (Scan folder button, folder pickers) and reach each share's .Recycle.Bin. Gives the container read/write access to all your shares, so leave it empty unless you need it. Keep the Container Path /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for the times shown in logs.

Config.Name: UI username
Config.Description: Login name for the web UI (only used when a password is set). Default admin.

Config.Name: UI password
Config.Description: Set a password to require a login for the web UI. Blank = no login.
